label: scansSubfolders: the scan reads only the top of Sources/<X>App/, skipping its subfolders
baselineMatchesLine: a baseline line matches its file only, not the line's text
find: static func key(file: String, text: String) -> String { file + ": " + text }
replace: static func key(file: String, text: String) -> String { file }

label: staleBaselineFails: a baseline line whose site is gone is ignored, so the baseline can grow stale
dismissOnlyDismisses: the dismiss rule matches any button title, so a Delete that dismisses passes
limitCaps: the baseline's max is read as a minimum, so a baseline can grow past it
